text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard a warm voice coming from 
over here, though...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh? Could it be... the Three Goddesses 
statue?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, it sounds just like an old fairy 
tale.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. If it were possible to talk to 
them, I'd certainly like to try.
